evidence.quote: tldr: Let’s accelerate pqai without rushing or stopping everything else. We can parallelise workstreams to keep shipping EIPs that are ready while the cryptography, designs, and specs for PQ are being worked on and finalised.

- Importantly, the major PQ/AI upgrades are not yet ready: the specs and the cryptography are not frozen (https://t.co/aGikvd49Kf). On the CL side, we don’t even know exactly what we mean by “PQ consensus” yet. Is it PQ Gasper? PQ Decoupled Consensus? With or without aggregation (and leanVM)? We need a lot more eyes on it, but it’s not realistic to think

The first is inclusion lists being able to cover PQ transactions. Here, the simple answer is that FOCIL, without any changes, would be able to include PQ transactions using leanSPHINCS signatures. But it would be able to include a lot fewer: a leanSPHINCS signature is around 5-7 kB and an IL is capped at 8 kB, so probably just 1 PQ transaction per IL, which
means up to 16 PQ txns per block (because there are 16 includers, each of them building 1 IL per block). I think that’s fine and good enough for Hegota.

I agree we should accelerate pqai, and prioritise every upgrade that is ready (PQ registration, leanSPHINCS). But DFI’ing everything else won’t make the parts that aren’t ready arrive any sooner. It only guarantees that Ethereum ships no user-facing features while we wait.

evidence.quote: Oripa 是一个 HyperEVM 抽实体收藏卡的平台。抽到卡后，你可以让平台寄给你，也可以卖回平台。如果抽到的卡低于抽卡价，系统还会发给你 $ORIPA。有点像之前 PaperTrade 的玩法。
2、要 USDC ，就按回收当天参考市价的 85% 卖回平台，这一步叫 Melt。超过 24 小时没选寄送，系统会自动回收。
系统记你亏了 100 − 20 = 80U，按上线初始速率发你 800 $ORIPA。如果抽到的卡锁定估值达到或超过 100U，这一抽就不发币。 如果当天价格仍是 20 U，你卖回去拿 17 U。所以这笔抽卡实际净花了 83 U，另外拿到 800 枚 $ORIPA 代币。
$ORIPA 的主要用途是质押分 USDC。每笔抽卡费的 5% 给质押者，此外加上卡片回收准备金、跨多笔抽卡结算后可分配的余额，还有上述「卡片利差」全部回馈给了质押者。
项目没有预售或私募。全平台累计记账亏损达到 500 万后，每亏 1 U发的币会逐步减少。玩家每拿到 100 枚，项目金库另外铸造 40 枚，总供应量会逐渐接近 7.7 亿枚。

items.author: GoPlusSecurity
items.new_information: PoC与技术细节已公开，并已演示认证前RCE；此前只告知修复已发布
items.urgency_reason: PoC已公开，自托管Jira、Jenkins等Java服务面临RCE风险，需尽快打补丁并重启JVM

evidence.quote: On November 17, 2026, Oracle and the OpenJDK project released security updates addressing CVE-2026-114938, a memory corruption vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell. The flaw affects HotSpot’s AVX-512 VBMI-accelerated Base64 decoding intrinsic and can lead to heap data disclosure, JVM crashes, and potentially remote code execution (RCE).

Oracle assigned the vulnerability a CVSS 3.1 score of 8.1 (High). A proof of concept and technical details are publicly available, although application-specific exploit chains remain withheld. Developers should assess their exposure and patch as soon as possible.

Affected releases include OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later unpatched builds in the Java 17, 21, 25, and 27 release lines. Distributions incorporating the affected code are also impacted, including Amazon Corretto, Eclipse Temurin, Azul Zulu, Microsoft Build of OpenJDK, and Red Hat OpenJDK.
- An x86-64 processor supporting AVX-512 VBMI and the associated required CPU features.

Researchers at Calif demonstrated pre-authentication RCE in controlled environments against Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Keycloak, Artifactory, and PingFederate, as well as post-authentication RCE against Kafka, Solr, Elasticsearch, Gerrit, and Spinnaker. Exploitability depends on the application and deployment; there is no universal exploit.

Restart affected JVMs after upgrading. For containerized applications, rebuild and redeploy images containing the patched runtime. Update bundled or embedded JREs using the method supported by the product vendor.

items.author: thedefiedge
items.new_information: 杠杆清算列为首因，并排除中期选举与币安被盗两种解释

evidence.quote: BTC fell 13% in three days.
#1: Leverage, set off by the Nvidia news
BTC closed that day at $73,974, and three days later it was at $64,120.
What made it so fast was leverage. About $1.3B of leveraged BTC longs got liquidated on Nov 13 and 14, and every forced sale pushed the price a bit lower and knocked out the next batch.
I'm not sure Nvidia was the trigger, but the liquidations line up almost perfectly with the steepest part of the drop.
When cash pays more, money comes out of risky stuff first. You can see it in the spot BTC ETFs, which had seven straight days of outflows from Nov 5 to 13, about $1.91B in total.
This explains why we're going down, but not why it happened so fast.
The two theories that don't hold up
• The midterms: Democrats won both the House and Senate on Nov 3.
That's bad news for crypto bills, but BTC actually went up from $76,709 to $80,443 in the two days after.
• The Binance hack: $6.3B was stolen on Oct 29, and a week later BTC was still at $80,443.

evidence.quote: We’re excited to announce that Null has raised $1.7M in pre-seed funding led by @cyberfund and @Nethermind, and angels @NoahZinsmeister, @sendmoodz and @oel4all.
Null 想做一类可以长期持有的合成代币。用户不必直接买入标的资产，也能通过代币参与股票、指数、大宗商品或加密资产的价格涨跌。按项目方的说法，交易时没有买卖点差，持有期间也不收资金费。

此外，两位前 Uniswap 工程主管参与了本次融资，成了 Null 的天使投资人。
Null 目前还在候补名单阶段，项目方尚未披露铸造和对冲机制，目前还很难判断模式能否跑通。
